questions.question: A has 20% less then B, How much percentage B has more than A?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

20% decrease in fraction = 1/5.

If A is 1/5 less than B, then B is more than A by 1/(5 − 1).

Required Percentage = 1/4 × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A has 20% less than B.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage More = [(Difference) ÷ (Base Value)] × 100

 
 B = 100 units
 
 A = 80 units
 
• 
 
• 
 Diff = 20
 B is (20 ÷ 80) × 100 more than A

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the value of B = 100

⇒ Value of A = 100 − 20% of 100 = 80

⇒ Difference between B and A = 100 − 80 = 20

⇒ Percentage B has more than A = (Difference ÷ A) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (20 ÷ 80) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 1/4 × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change Rule

If A is R% less than B, then B is more than A by [R ÷ (100 − R)] × 100%.

Inverse Percentage Rule

If A is R% more than B, then B is less than A by [R ÷ (100 + R)] × 100%.

Fractional Equivalent

Common conversions: 20% = 1/5, 25% = 1/4, 33.33% = 1/3, 50% = 1/2.</p

questions.question: What is the least number which, when divided by 60, 84, and 96, leaves remainders of 28, 52, and 64, respectively?
questions.solution:

The least number which, when divided by 60, 84, and 96, leaves remainders of 28, 52, and 64, respectively.

**Calculations:**

(84 - 52) = 32 and

questions.question: Vaishali booked a bus ticket for Rs. 1,260. Because of her ill health, she had to cancel the ticket. She got a refund of Rs. 945 in this process. What is the percentage loss that Vaishali had to face?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Original price of the ticket = Rs. 1,260.

Refund amount = Rs. 945.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage loss = (Loss / Original price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Loss = Original price - Refund amount

⇒ Loss = 1260 - 945

⇒ Loss = Rs. 315

Percentage loss = (315 / 1260) × 100

Percentage loss = (1 / 4) × 100

Percentage loss = 25%

**The percentage loss that Vaishali had to face is 25%.**

questions.question: A & B together finishes a work in 10 days. B & C together finishes same work in 18 days. A works 5 days on this work firstly then B worked for 10 days and the remaining work is done by C in 15 days. If C alone do this work then in how many days he will take to complete the work.
questions.solution:
Work done by A & B = 10 days

Work done by A & B in one day = 1/10 work

Work done by B & C = 18 days

Work done by B & C in one day = 1/18 work

Let C finishes the work in x days.

∴ Work done by C in one day = 1/x

∵ B + C = 1/18

C = 1/x

∴ B = 1/18 – 1/x

∵ A + B = 1/10

∴ A = 1/10 – (1/18 – 1/x)

Total work done = 1

∴ A × (5 days) + B × (5 days) + C × (10 days) = 1

5 × (1/10) + 5 × (1/18) + 10 × (1/x) = 1

10/x = 1 – (5/10 + 5/18)

∴ x = 45 days.

C will complete the work 45 days.

questions.question: If both the radius and height of a right circular cone are increased by 25%, its volume will be increased by: (Approximation up to two decimal points) (Where pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

If both the radius and height of a right circular cone are increased by 25%, its volume will be increased by:

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone, V = (1/3)πr²h

**Calculation:**

Initial volume, V₁ = (1/3)πr²h

New radius, r' = r × 1.25

New height, h' = h × 1.25

New volume, V₂ = (1/3)π(r × 1.25)²(h × 1.25)

⇒ V₂ = (1/3)π(r² × 1.25²)(h × 1.25)

⇒ V₂ = (1/3)π(r² × 1.5625)(h × 1.25)

⇒ V₂ = (1/3)πr²h × 1.953125

⇒ V₂ = V₁ × 1.953125

Increase in volume = V₂ - V₁

⇒ Increase in volume = V₁ × 1.953125 - V₁

⇒ Increase in volume = V₁ (1.953125 - 1)

⇒ Increase in volume = V₁ × 0.953125

⇒ Percentage increase in volume = 0.953125 × 100%

⇒ Percentage increase in volume ≈ 95.31%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question:
If the curved surface area of a hemisphere is 693 m², find the diameter (in m) of the sphere.

(Let π =(22)/(7) ).
questions.solution:
**Given:****

The curved surface area of a hemisphere = 693 m²

Formula used:**

The curved surface area of a hemisphere = 2πr² (where r = Radius)

**Calculation:**

According to the formula, 

 2πr² = 693 

⇒ r2 = 693 / 2π

⇒ r2 = 693 / (2 × 22/7)

⇒r2 = (693 × 7) / (2 × 22)

⇒ r2 = (63 × 7) / (2 × 2)

⇒ r = √{(9 × 7 × 7) / 4}

⇒ r = (3 × 7) / 4

⇒ r = 21 / 2

Diameter = 2r = 21

**∴ The diameter of the sphere is 21. **

questions.question: The areas of the three adjacent faces of a closed cuboidal box are 120 cm², 60 cm² and 72 cm² respectively. Then, the total surface area of the box is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total surface area of a cuboid is exactly twice the sum of the areas of its three adjacent faces.

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (Sum of adjacent faces)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (120 + 60 + 72)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 252 = 504 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 504 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The areas of three adjacent faces of the closed cuboidal box are 120 cm², 60 cm², and 72 cm².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/973537677fb85f2570b01e160f349f946051beab5395c39c1a0e1f3d6ddc65ff.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Where l, b, and h are the length, breadth, and height of the cuboid.

**Calculations:**

Let the length, breadth, and height of the box be l, b, and h respectively.

⇒ Area of the first face (lb) = 120 cm²

⇒ Area of the second face (bh) = 60 cm²

⇒ Area of the third face (hl) = 72 cm²

Substitute these given areas directly into the total surface area formula:

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (120 + 60 + 72)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 252

⇒ Total Surface Area = 504 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 504 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

If A₁, A₂, and A₃ are the areas of the three adjacent faces, the volume V is given directly by the square root of their product: V = √(A₁ × A₂ × A₃).

Lateral Surface Area

The lateral surface area (area of the four vertical walls) of a cuboid is given by 2h(l + b), which excludes the top and bottom faces.

Length of Diagonal

The length of the longest diagonal possible inside a given cuboid is calculated as √(l² + b² + h²).

questions.question: 40 litres of milk are kept in a container. 4 litres of milk were removed from this container and replaced with water. This procedure was performed two more times. How much milk does the container now hold?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total quantity (x) = 40 litres, quantity replaced (y) = 4 litres, total operations (n) = 3.

Remaining milk = x × (1 − y/x)ⁿ

Remaining milk = 40 × (1 − 4/40)³ = 40 × (9/10)³

Remaining milk = 40 × 0.729 = 29.16 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 29.16 litres.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Initial amount of milk = 40 litres

Amount removed and replaced by water = 4 litres

Total number of times the process is performed = 1 (initially) + 2 (more) = 3 times

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/939c49c25063f8c5ad2599123e1f6600a94b41a5a54e872418a609568e8c09a5.png] 

Formula Used:

Final Quantity = Initial Quantity × (1 − Replaced Quantity / Total Quantity)Time

Calculations:

⇒ Quantity of milk after 1st replacement = 40 − 4 = 36 litres

⇒ Ratio of milk remaining after each replacement = (40 − 4) ÷ 40 = 36/40 = 9/10

⇒ Milk left after 3 operations = 40 × (9/10) × (9/10) × (9/10)

⇒ Milk left = 40 × (729 / 1000)

⇒ Milk left = 4 × 72.9 / 10

⇒ Milk left = 291.6 / 10 = 29.16 litres

**∴ The correct answer is 29.16 litres.**

**__Additional Information__**

General Replacement Formula

Amount of pure liquid left = P × (1 − R/P)ⁿ, where P is initial quantity, R is quantity replaced, and n is number of cycles.

Ratio of Ingredients

The ratio of the original liquid to the replacing liquid (water) after n operations is [P × (1 − R/P)ⁿ] : [P − (P × (1 − R/P)ⁿ)].

Percentage Purity

Final concentration percentage = (Initial concentration) × (1 − R/P)ⁿ.</p

questions.question: Due to a fall of 20% in the rates of wheat a man can buy 10 kg more than before for Rs 600. What is the decreased rate per kg?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Decreased Rate = (Reduction % × Total Expenditure) ÷ Extra Quantity

Reduction = 20% of ₹600 = ₹120

This ₹120 is the cost of the extra 10 kg wheat at the new rate.

Decreased Rate = 120 ÷ 10 = ₹12.00 per kg

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12.00.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Expenditure = ₹600

Reduction in Price = 20%

Increase in Quantity = 10 kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01adb9af943c2f80d0cc6cb16930e06e6632865d28162a17e844eeceeb5e1569.png] 

Let the original rate per kg be x.

⇒ Original quantity = 600 ÷ x

⇒ Decreased rate = 80% of x = 0.8x

⇒ New quantity = 600 ÷ (0.8x) = 750 ÷ x

⇒ Difference in quantity = (750 ÷ x) − (600 ÷ x) = 10

⇒ 150 ÷ x = 10

⇒ x = 150 ÷ 10 = ₹15 (Original Rate)

⇒ Decreased rate = 0.8 × 15 = ₹12.00

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12.00.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Price and Consumption Relation

When expenditure is constant, Price is inversely proportional to Consumption (P ∝ 1/C). If price decreases by r%, consumption must increase to keep expenditure same.

Direct Formula for Original Rate

Original Rate = (r × E) ÷ [(100 − r) × q], where r = % reduction, E = expenditure, q = extra quantity.

Direct Formula for Decreased Rate

Decreased Rate = (r × E) ÷ (100 × q). This gives the new price per unit directly after the percentage change.

questions.question: A and B started a business with Rs. 15000 and Rs. 30000 respectively. If A and B share profit in the ratio of 1 ∶ 5 respectively, then what is the ratio of the time period of investment for A and B respectively?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Capital ratio A : B = 15000 : 30000 = 1 : 2

Profit ratio A : B = 1 : 5

Time Ratio = (Profit Ratio ÷ Capital Ratio)

Time Ratio A : B = (1 ÷ 1) : (5 ÷ 2) = 1 : 2.5

Time Ratio A : B = 2 : 5

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Investment of A (CA) = Rs. 15000

Investment of B (CB) = Rs. 30000

Profit Ratio (PA : PB) = 1 : 5

Formula used: Profit = Capital × Time period

 
 Capital A (Rs. 15000)
 
 Capital B (Rs. 30000)
 
• 
 Profit Ratio (A : B) = 1 : 5
 Time Ratio = (P / C) = (1/1) : (5/2) = 2 : 5

⇒ PA / PB = (CA × TA) / (CB × TB)

⇒ 1 / 5 = (15000 × TA) / (30000 × TB)

⇒ 1 / 5 = (1 × TA) / (2 × TB)

⇒ TA / TB = (1 × 2) / (5 × 1)

⇒ TA / TB = 2 / 5

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Partnership Rule

When two or more people invest capital for different time periods, the profit is shared in the ratio of the product of their capital and time: P₁ : P₂ = C₁T₁ : C₂T₂.

Time Period Ratio Formula

If the profit ratio and capital ratio are known, the time period ratio is found by dividing the profit units by capital units: T₁ : T₂ = (P₁ ÷ C₁) : (P₂ ÷ C₂).

Working vs Sleeping Partner

A working partner manages the business and may receive a fixed salary or commission from the profit before the remaining profit is shared among all partners.</p

questions.question: A single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 10%, 5% and 3(1)/(2)% will be ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Successive discounts = 10%, 5%, 3.5%

**Concept:**

Successive discounts can be computed using the formula: net discount = 1 - (1 - d1) × (1 - d2) × ...

**Solution:**

⇒ Net discount = 1 - (1 - 0.1) × (1 - 0.05) × (1 - 0.035)

⇒ Net discount = 1 - 0.9 × 0.95 × 0.965 = 0.174925

**Hence, a single discount equivalent to the three successive discounts is 0.174925 or 17.4925%**

questions.question: ABC is an isosceles triangle in which AB = AC and ∠*BAC* = 50°. Side BC is extended to D. Find the measure of ∠*ACD*.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ABC is an isosceles triangle

AB = AC and ∠*BAC* = 50°

BC is extended to D

**Concept used:**

Sum of all the angles in a triangle = 180° 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/992b537ceb8c1be2ab5f4c286c594ca97f72b8b721da533548a85a7a2e36a17c.png] 

In triangle ABC,

∠ ABC + ∠BCA + ∠ BAC = 180° 

⇒ 2 ∠ ACB + ∠ BAC = 180° ......[Angles opposite to equal sides are equal]

⇒ 2 ∠ ACB + 50° = 180° 

⇒ 2 ∠ ACB = 180° - 50° 

⇒ ∠ ACB = 130°/2 = 65° 

Now for ∠ ACD,

⇒ ∠ ACB + ∠ ACD = 180° ......[Linear Pair]

⇒ 65° + ∠ ACD = 180° 

⇒ ∠ ACD = 180° - 65° = 115° 

**∴ The measure of ∠ACD is 115°. **

questions.question: The average speed of a car which covers half the distance with a speed of 20 km/hr and the other half with a speed of 30 km/hr, will be:
questions.solution:
Formula: 

Average speed = Total distance covered ÷ Total time 

Calculation:

Let the total distance be 240 km

Time for which speed is 20 km/hr = 120over20 = 6 hrs

Time for which speed is 30 km/hr = 120over30 = 4 hrs

Total time = 6 + 4 = 10 hrs

Average speed = 240over10 = 24 km/h

The average speed is 24 km/h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Average speed = 2times {S₁times S₂}over{S₁+S₂}, where S₁ and S₂ are the speeds respectively.

Substituting the values of speeds, we get-

⇒ Average speed = 2times {20×30}over{20+30} = 1200over50 = 24 km/hr

questions.question: The mean proportional between 35 and a certain number N is four times the mean proportional between 14 and 30. The number N is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Squaring the mean proportional relation directly: 35 × N = 4² × (14 × 30)

⇒ 35 × N = 16 × 420

⇒ N = (16 × 420) ÷ 35

⇒ N = 16 × 12 = 192

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b26030d7237b4a277e5240f0872fdd554d81df55df7a6afe6745031b89fd97c3.png] 

**Given:**

First pair of numbers = 35 and N

Second pair of numbers = 14 and 30

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mean proportional of 35 and N = √(35 × N)

⇒ Mean proportional of 14 and 30 = √(14 × 30) = √420

According to the given condition:

⇒ √(35 × N) = 4 × √420

Squaring both sides of the equation:

⇒ 35 × N = 16 × 420

⇒ N = (16 × 420) ÷ 35

⇒ N = 16 × 12

⇒ N = 192

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional (or geometric mean) between two given numbers a and b is √(ab).

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is known as the third proportional, given by c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three distinct numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional x satisfies the condition a : b :: c : x, which is calculated as x = (b × c) ÷ a.
</p

**Concept:**

For a square to be inscribed in a circle, its diagonal is equal to the diameter of the circle.

Let the side of the square be a 

Diagonal = a × √2

**Solution:**

Since the diagonal of the square equals the diameter of the circle,

a × √2 = 2 × radius = 2 × 14 = 28 cm

a = 28 ÷ √2 = 14√2 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65e6d9e1a087cbfa80c02f18df62ee4177cb4584f691c06e3cbb2e8e90bf2c49.png] 

The area of the square is:

Aₛ = a² = (14√2)² = 196 × 2 = 392 cm² 

The area of the circle is,

A꜀ = π × r² = (22 ÷ 7) × 14² = (22 ÷ 7) × 196 = 616 cm².

Remaining area = A꜀ - Aₛ = 616 - 392 = **224 cm²**.
